lines: Many children in South Africa die every year.
They get sick because they have dirty water and food.
They also get sick because they eat with dirty hands.
Doctors say, “We should wash our hands often.
That is important for good health.”
Some people wanted to help the children in South Africa.
They had an idea for them.
Hope Soap is a bar of soap.
It has a small toy inside.
Children can get the toy when they use the soap.
Thanks to Hope Soap, children in South Africa are becoming healthy.
They wash their hands more often than before!
